_comment: Human-owned acceptance constants for the gate config. Vignan edits these, then runs `uv run python scripts/sign_config.py` to pin the three catalogs and sign. The script fills in the code-derived digests (gate library, control catalog, the three catalogs); do NOT add those by hand.
_mie_note: mde (0.005) is the DETECTABILITY floor; mie_floor (0.01) is the INTEREST floor and must stay strictly above mde. 0.01 matches the lenient SSv2 per-task MIE (K400 is 0.011). NOTE: runner.py currently reads this flat mie_floor as THE operative MIE; the per-task mie_distribution catalog value is pinned by signing but not yet resolved per-task in the runner. Set mie_floor to the target task's catalog MIE per campaign until that resolution is wired.
